introduction: In Andhra Pradesh, the Integrated Caste Certificate certifies Community, Nativity, and Date of Birth details (SC, ST, BC, and OC communities). It is processed through the official AP Seva Portal, allowing citizens to apply online without needing to visit a physical center for the application phase.
quickFacts:
Important to Know
  • Service Name: Integrated Caste Certificate (Community, Nativity & Date of Birth Certificate)
  • State: Andhra Pradesh
  • Official Online Portal: AP Seva Portal
  • Application Types: Fresh Issue (for new applicants) & Re-issue/Renewal (for existing certificate holders or using family records).
  • Application Fee: Rs. 50 (for online payment).
  • File Upload Requirements: All documents must be uploaded in PDF format and should be below 1 MB in size.
documentsRequired:
Documents Required

Mandatory Documents
  • Aadhaar Card: Mandatory ID proof (Ration Card or Voter ID can also be used, uploaded as a PDF).
  • Filled Application Form: Scanned copy of the physical Integrated Caste Certificate application form (PDF format).
  • Old Caste Certificate: Previous caste certificate of a family member, if available (PDF format).
Optional Proofs
  • Educational Certificates (Optional): SSC Marks Memo / Date of Birth Certificate / Transfer Certificate.
  • Study Certificates (Optional): 1st to 10th class Bonafide/Study certificates.
onlineApplication:
Online Application

  1. Step 1: Open your web browser and search for "AP Seva Portal" or directly visit the website.
  2. Step 2: Click on Login (top right) and select Citizen Login. Log in using your registered Email ID. If you don't have an account, click on "Create one" to sign up.
  3. Step 3: On the main dashboard, go to the Services section, click on Revenue, and select Integrated Certificates.
  4. Step 4: Enter the applicant's Aadhaar Number and click on the Pre-fill button.
  5. Step 5 (For Re-issue): If you already have a caste certificate issued in the past, an alert box with your previous certificate number will pop up. Click "OK", pay the ₹50 renewal fee directly, and get your renewal certificate generated instantly. If someone in your family has one, you can also search using their Application Number or District/Mandal details to fetch records and pay without submitting new documents.
  6. Step 6 (For Fresh Issue): If you are a new applicant, close the alert and manually review/fill the application form. Verify pre-filled Aadhaar details and enter Father/Husband's name.
  7. Step 7: Select the Gender, Date of Birth, Caste, Religion, Applicant Qualification, and Marital Status.
  8. Step 8: Verify the Aadhaar-linked mobile number by entering the OTP sent to your phone. Select "Yes" or "No" if you want application updates via WhatsApp.
  9. Step 9: Fill in your Permanent and Present Addresses. If both are the same, check the respective box to auto-fill. Click Continue.
  10. Step 10: (Optional) Enter your Ration Card details and select whether you are using this service for a grievance.
  11. Step 11: Under the Caste Certificate section, select Address Type (Present/Permanent), select if a certificate was issued to you in the past, choose your exact Sub-Caste, specify if your education certificate contains your caste, and select the Purpose of the Certificate (type "General" if unsure). Select your Revenue Village/Ward.
  12. Step 12: Upload the required documents in the specified sections (Application form, family caste certificate, Aadhaar/Voter ID, and optional educational certificates). Make sure they are cropped, in PDF format, and below 1 MB.
  13. Step 13: Check the Terms & Conditions boxes at the bottom and click on Show Payment.
  14. Step 14: Verify the payment details (₹50) and click Continue Payment. Scan the QR code or use Cards/UPI to complete the payment.
  15. Step 15: Once paid, the screen will redirect and generate an Application Receipt. Save/download this receipt for tracking.
  16. Step 16 (Offline Visit): After processing, you will receive an approval SMS. Visit your nearest MeeSeva Center with your application number to get the finalized original Integrated Caste Certificate printed.
offlineApplication:
Offline Application

  1. Step 1: Download the "Integrated Caste Certificate Application Form" from the AP MeeSeva portal or collect a physical copy from your nearest Gram/Ward Sachivalayam (Secretariat) or MeeSeva Center.
  2. Step 2: Fill the application form clearly with your personal details, parent's details, address, and the caste you belong to.
  3. Step 3: Attach photocopies of the required documents (Aadhaar Card, old caste certificates of family members, Ration card, and educational certificates).
  4. Step 4: Visit your nearest Village/Ward Secretariat or MeeSeva Center and submit the application package to the operator.
  5. Step 5: Pay the required offline application fee at the counter and collect your computer-generated acknowledgment slip.
afterApplying:
After Applying

  • Securely save your payment receipt or acknowledgment slip containing your Application / Reference Number.
  • You will receive updates on your registered mobile number via SMS (and WhatsApp, if you opted for it) indicating the status of your application.
  • Wait for the approval notification. Once approved, the document is permanently saved in the government database.
  • You must make an offline visit to the nearest MeeSeva center, provide them with your reference number, and pay a nominal print charge to get your final, physical certificate.
